## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Axes
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Axis3D conversions and algebra
//  - Axis2D conversions and algebra
//  - SignedAxis3D conversions and algebra

library Axes
{
    //==
    // # Axis3D conversions and algebra
    //
    // Total, one-way conversions from the unsigned 3D cardinal axis (`axes.types.plato`)
    // out to the geometric vocabulary — basis vector, unit direction, Number tuple,
    // point — plus the component selector and the right-handed tangent cycle.

    // The unit basis vector along this axis: X => (1,0,0), Y => (0,1,0), Z => (0,0,1).
    Vector3D(self: Axis3D): Vector3D
        => match (self) {
            X => Vector3D.UnitX;
            Y => Vector3D.UnitY;
            Z => Vector3D.UnitZ;
        };

    // The unit direction along this axis (the basis vector, already unit length).
    Direction3D(self: Axis3D): Direction3D
        => Direction3D(self.Vector3D);

    // The basis vector as a raw Number3 tuple.
    Number3(self: Axis3D): Number3
        => match (self) {
            X => (1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            Y => (0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
            Z => (0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        };

    // The point one unit along this axis from the origin.
    Point3D(self: Axis3D): Point3D
        => match (self) {
            X => (1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            Y => (0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
            Z => (0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        };

    // The zero-based component index this axis selects: X => 0, Y => 1, Z => 2.
    Ordinal(self: Axis3D): Integer
        => match (self) {
            X => 0;
            Y => 1;
            Z => 2;
        };

    // The component of v that this axis selects (`Component(v, X)` is `v.X`).
    Component(v: Vector3D, axis: Axis3D): Number
        => match (axis) {
            X => v.X;
            Y => v.Y;
            Z => v.Z;
        };

    // The next axis in the right-handed cycle X => Y => Z => X. Together with
    // Bitangent this gives an oriented frame around the axis.
    Tangent(self: Axis3D): Axis3D
        => match (self) {
            X => Axis3D.Y;
            Y => Axis3D.Z;
            Z => Axis3D.X;
        };

    // The axis after Tangent in the right-handed cycle (Tangent of Tangent):
    // X => Z, Y => X, Z => Y.
    Bitangent(self: Axis3D): Axis3D
        => match (self) {
            X => Axis3D.Z;
            Y => Axis3D.X;
            Z => Axis3D.Y;
        };

    //==
    // # Axis2D conversions and algebra
    //
    // Total, one-way conversions from the unsigned 2D cardinal axis (`axes.types.plato`)
    // out to the geometric vocabulary — basis vector, unit direction, Number tuple,
    // point — plus the component selector and the quarter-turn partner.

    // The unit basis vector along this axis: X => (1,0), Y => (0,1).
    Vector2D(self: Axis2D): Vector2D
        => match (self) {
            X => Vector2D.UnitX;
            Y => Vector2D.UnitY;
        };

    // The unit direction along this axis (the basis vector, already unit length).
    Direction2D(self: Axis2D): Direction2D
        => Direction2D(self.Vector2D);

    // The basis vector as a raw Number2 tuple.
    Number2(self: Axis2D): Number2
        => match (self) {
            X => (1.0, 0.0);
            Y => (0.0, 1.0);
        };

    // The point one unit along this axis from the origin.
    Point2D(self: Axis2D): Point2D
        => match (self) {
            X => (1.0, 0.0);
            Y => (0.0, 1.0);
        };

    // The zero-based component index this axis selects: X => 0, Y => 1.
    Ordinal(self: Axis2D): Integer
        => match (self) {
            X => 0;
            Y => 1;
        };

    // The component of v that this axis selects (`Component(v, X)` is `v.X`).
    Component(v: Vector2D, axis: Axis2D): Number
        => match (axis) {
            X => v.X;
            Y => v.Y;
        };

    // The other 2D axis: X => Y, Y => X (the quarter-turn partner).
    Perpendicular(self: Axis2D): Axis2D
        => match (self) {
            X => Axis2D.Y;
            Y => Axis2D.X;
        };

    //==
    // # SignedAxis3D conversions and algebra
    //
    // Total, one-way conversions from the oriented 3D cardinal axis (`axes.types.plato`)
    // out to the geometric vocabulary — unsigned axis, sense, unit vector, unit
    // direction — plus the opposite-orientation flip.

    // The unsigned axis this oriented axis lies along (drops the sign).
    Axis3D(self: SignedAxis3D): Axis3D
        => match (self) {
            PosX => Axis3D.X;
            NegX => Axis3D.X;
            PosY => Axis3D.Y;
            NegY => Axis3D.Y;
            PosZ => Axis3D.Z;
            NegZ => Axis3D.Z;
        };

    // The sense of this axis: +1 for the positive faces, -1 for the negative faces.
    Sign(self: SignedAxis3D): Integer
        => match (self) {
            PosX => 1;
            NegX => -1;
            PosY => 1;
            NegY => -1;
            PosZ => 1;
            NegZ => -1;
        };
```
